title.narrative: Supporting the LDC Group under the UNFCCC

description.narrative: As part of its Climate Diplomacy program, GGGI aims to provide the LDC Group with targeted technical assistance and capacity-enhancing activities in transparency, adaptation, and mitigation to empower LDCs to better position themselves during climate negotiations. Through the FCDO funding, GGGI will support the LDC Group Chair in preparation for the upcoming COP28, including backstopping the chairmanship handover process and ensuring a smooth leadership transition.

The project aims to:-Promote the implementation of the Paris Agreement and the transition to low-carbon and climate-resilient economies. Through research and experience sharing, enhance understanding and readiness for the performance of the Paris Agreement while discussing implementation challenges such as establishing governance arrangements, attracting finance, long-term planning, and tracking NDC progress, among others.-Support countries in building the capacity to engage in the UNFCCC negotiations. The Action will support countries in developing a plan, list of agreed priorities, and engagement strategy for the UNFCCC negotiations at the technical and Ministerial levels.
